// @provenance rule: rule_struct
pub struct Payroll {
    hours: u32,
}

// @provenance rule: rule_impl_block
impl Payroll {
    pub fn pays(&self) -> bool {
        self.hours > 38
    }
}

// @provenance rule: rule_enum
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub(crate) enum Shift {
    Day,
}

/// A ledger of entries.
// @provenance rule: rule_generic_struct
#[derive(
    Debug,
    Default,
)]
pub struct Ledger<T> {
    entries: Vec<T>,
}

// @provenance rule: rule_const_fn
pub const fn limit() -> u32 {
    38
}

// @provenance rule: rule_async_fn
pub(crate) async unsafe fn pays_overtime(
    hours: u32,
) -> bool {
    hours > 38
}

// @provenance rule: rule_trait
pub trait Rates {
    fn rate(&self) -> u32;
}

// @provenance rule: rule_alias
pub type Hours = u32;

#[rule("rule_attribute_enum")]
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Kind {
    Day,
}

#[rule("rule_attribute_struct")]
pub struct Entry;

#[rule("rule_attribute_impl")]
impl Payroll {
    fn other(&self) {}
}

// @provenance rule: rule_const_then_doc
pub const LIMIT: u32 = 38;

/// The pay rule.
///
/// It reads the hours.
pub fn unrelated() {}

// @provenance rule: rule_static
pub static NAME: &str = "payroll";

// @provenance rule: rule_mod
mod tests {
    fn helper() {}
}

// @provenance rule: rule_long_derive
#[derive(
    Debug,
    Clone,
    Copy,
    PartialEq,
    Eq,
)]
pub struct Wide;

#[rule("rule_attribute_long_derive")]
#[derive(
    Debug,
    Clone,
    Copy,
    PartialEq,
    Eq,
)]
pub struct WideEntry;

// @provenance rule: rule_raw_identifier
pub fn r#match() {}

// @provenance rule: rule_block_comment
/* block
 */ pub fn hidden_after_block() {}
pub fn below_block() {}

// @provenance rule: rule_inline_comment
/* note */ pub fn inline_after_comment() {}
pub fn next_after_inline() {}

pub fn counts() {
    // @provenance rule: rule_deref_statement
    *counter() += 1;
    fn nested_helper() {}
}

// @provenance rule: rule_nested_comment
/* outer /* inner */ fn commented() {} */
pub fn after_nested() {}

#[rule("rule_stacked_first")]
#[rule("rule_stacked_second")]
pub fn stacked() {}

// @provenance rule: rule_union
pub union Bits {
    whole: u32,
}

// @provenance rule: rule_unsafe_fn
pub unsafe fn raw_hours() {}

// @provenance rule: rule_extern_fn
pub extern "C" fn exported_hours() {}

impl Ledger {
    // @provenance rule: rule_default_fn
    default fn total() {}
}

// @provenance rule: rule_group_comment_first

// @provenance rule: rule_group_comment_second
fn grouped_comments() {}

#[rule("rule_group_blank_second")]
fn grouped_blank() {}

#[test]
#[verifies("rule_group_test_second", examples)]
fn grouped_test() {}

#[rule("rule_group_plain_first")]

#[rule("rule_group_const_first")]
const LIMIT: u32 = 38;
#[rule("rule_group_const_second")]
fn after_const() {}

fn sums(hours: u32) -> u32 {
    hours
        // @provenance rule: rule_after_operator
        + extra(hours)
}

fn calls() {
    pays(
        // @provenance rule: rule_call_argument
        fn_hours,
    );
}

const OPENS: &str = r#"a"/*"#;
#[rule("rule_after_raw_string")]
fn after_raw_string() {}
